question_text: A 57-year-old woman comes to the physician for evaluation of a lump in the right breast that she first noticed a week ago. Biopsy of the mass confirms a diagnosis of a pleomorphic lobular carcinoma-in-situ that is estrogen receptor-positive. The patient undergoes lumpectomy, and treatment with tamoxifen is initiated. Which of the following conditions is most likely to occur as a result of tamoxifen therapy?
